newsitem.title: USA: Eljer Industries stake cut by Gabelli group.
newsitem.headline: Eljer Industries stake cut by Gabelli group.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said Monday it cut its stake in Eljer Industries Inc to 531,700 common shares or 7.43 percent from 9.08 percent held on December 26.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the sale of 28,000 common shares betweeen December 31 and January 2 at price ranging from $23.6250 to $23.75 per share.
The Dallas, Texas company is a manufacturer of plumbing and heating equipment, ventilators and air conditioning products.
